scope: Alberta operating well licence counts and atlas usability fixes
definitions: Marginal wells are active wells averaging less than 10 BOE/day. Operating sums AER’s separate Active and Marginal categories. These province-wide licence totals are separate from mapped source records.
sourceVerification: Independent reviewer downloaded the official CSV, matched its hash and checked the embedded workbook and definitions.
tests: 5 Python parser, schema drift, counts and offline-provenance tests
Hidden desktop and 390px mobile actual browser tests
Searchable province picker, keyboard navigation, Escape and outside click
Unsupported mapped statuses show unavailable, never zero
refresh: Scheduled and deployment workflows verify and ingest the public CSV. Offline replay preserves the verified acquisition date.
recordLevelStatus: ST37 is available but contains multiple production strings per licence. Legal licence status is not operational status; unreviewed production-string aggregation is not used as an active-well map.
